what_happened.line: The Sewer Commission met to add one article to the Nov 17 special town meeting warrant, moving Highfield Village agreement money into the sewer stabilization fund.
The article would set the money aside to cover capacity charges owed to Fitchburg in FY22, with the remainder held in stabilization until FY23.
A motion and second to put the article on the warrant by roll call were made; the captions do not show the result.
Fitchburg said paying early would only produce a credit and let it hold the money, so early payment was not pursued.
Next meetings were set for September 29th and October 13th at 5 p.m., remote until further notice.

why_it_matters: Money cannot go into a stabilization fund without a town meeting vote, so residents at the Nov 17 special town meeting will be asked to approve this article.
If approved, the money would earn interest for the sewer fund and help cover Fitchburg capacity charges in FY22, which bears on the sewer rates that ratepayers pay.
